proves: The closure mechanism's decision logic is reproducible from the shipped contract, and the refusal branches — no local repair, no self-declared f, no homogeneous review parties, no missing non-AI path, no resumption on one pass, no majority-rule F1 resumption — fire where the proposal says they do.
proves_not: Nothing here is a field measurement. No real readings, no real review parties, no service performance, and no evidence that anyone would take a reading. The numbers are worked values chosen to exercise branches; treating them as operational evidence would be the substitution this proposal argues against.

results.rule: f <= F is level for this cycle and the scenario continues
f > F returns the whole route, not the failing station
rule 5: amending only the worst station is not an available action
reasons: record.stations: needs at least 3 items, has 2
review parties: 2 distinct across the circuit; a reading taken by one kind of party cannot detect what that kind of party cannot see

results.rule: a record does not get to state its own f
reasons: verdict.f declares 0.13 but the stations recompute to 0.360000
verdict.passed says true but f 0.360 against F 0.2 derives false
verdict.action is "continue" but f against F requires "return-whole-route"

results.rule: a circuit read by one kind of party cannot detect what that party cannot see
reasons: review parties: 1 distinct across the circuit; a reading taken by one kind of party cannot detect what that kind of party cannot see

results.rule: without an equivalent non-AI path the stop rule would be circumvented
reasons: record.verdict.non_ai_path_available: must be true, got false
verdict.non_ai_path_available is false: a scenario with no non-AI equivalent cannot be returned, because returning it would interrupt public service — so the stop rule would be circumvented

results.rule: omitting the non-AI path field is not the same as satisfying it
reasons: verdict.non_ai_path_available is absent: the equivalent non-AI path is not waivable, so omitting the field cannot be treated as satisfying it. State it explicitly as true.

results.rule: a connecting route must terminate at a first-order benchmark, or nothing checks the carried value
reasons: stations[last]: a connecting route must terminate at a first-order benchmark, because the carried value has nothing to be checked against otherwise. This one ends at BM-302 (third).

results.rule: rule 7: two consecutive passes are required, because once may be luck
reasons: resumption needs two consecutive passing cycles, record shows 1; once may be luck

results.rule: rule 7: an F1 incident resumes only on unanimous confirmation, no majority rule
reasons: resumption after an F1 incident requires unanimous confirmation by all four review categories
